Coverage limited to local artifact analysis: PowerShell EventID 4104 ScriptBlock log reassembly across MessageNumber 1..3, Windows Registry triage parsing, recycle bin $I FILETIME conversion, HMAC-SHA256-CTR replication in Python.

The decryption tag MATCHES, providing cryptographic confirmation.  Plaintext = DUTCTF{usb_recycle_bin_timeline_unlocks_the_vault}.
